tool.summary: Assigns points to square spatial blocks and assigns whole blocks to k folds balanced by point count, for spatially blocked train/test splits (Roberts et al. 2017). An optional buffer drops training points that lie close to each fold's test blocks.
tool.usage:
Choose a block size at least as large as the range of spatial autocorrelation in the data.

All points in a block share a fold, so near neighbours never sit on both sides of a split.

The block grid is aligned to multiples of the block size, so reruns give the same blocks.

Give a class field to see per-fold class counts and a warning when a class is missing from a fold.

Without a buffer, points on either side of a block edge can still be close. With a buffer, SPLIT_F1..SPLIT_Fk fields give each point's role when fold f is the test set: 1 = test, 0 = train, 2 = excluded from training (within the buffer of a test block). Train on SPLIT_Ff = 0, test on SPLIT_Ff = 1.
